name: keni
description: Keni — a regional, supply-first mutual-matching app for children's-home recruitment (MVP).

scripts.build: prisma generate && (export DIRECT_URL="${DIRECT_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}"; prisma migrate deploy || prisma db push --skip-generate || echo '⚠️  prisma migrate deploy failed (DB unreachable at build time) — continuing build; apply migrations out-of-band') && next build
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL="${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres@localhost:5433/keni_test?schema=public}" DIRECT_URL="${TEST_DIRECT_URL:-${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres@localhost:5433/keni_test?schema=public}}" sh -c 'prisma db push --force-reset --skip-generate > /dev/null && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts'
